column7: Funko 4-pack (Xenomorph 731, Negan ToysRUs, Invincible Conquest chase, Demogorgon chase); each ~$15-35 so lot ~$90 (estimate), less than 3x $50
Brass peacock-fan fireplace screen with figure; typical sold $150-300 (estimate), asking $200 is near value, no 3x

Sealed baseball/UFC hobby boxes: 2x Topps 2023 Series 2, Bowman Chrome Mega, Topps Big League 2023, Topps 2021 box (2 auto/box), Prizm UFC blaster, UFC Chronicles blaster; est ~$30-90 each, lot $240-350 (estimate, no sold pages retrievable); check boxes factory sealed, no tears/shrink tampering, which Topps S2 are hobby/jumbo vs retail
Panasonic FZ200 in box but seller wants a Switch 2 trade (not a $0 giveaway); ~$150-200 sold, no realistic cheap buy

Original Peloton Bike + shoes + mat visible; used original bikes sell ~$300-450 local (estimate); $100 may be misprice/placeholder so confirm; check screen works, pedal/crank, power cord, subscription not needed to ride; 135 lb, 2 people or dolly
Japanese Psyduck art-rare style cards, several copies in toploaders; singles ~$5-15 each (estimate), below 3x $80
Built LEGO-type architecture/castle models in a box, unclear brand, weight unknown; not clearly worth $100+
One Piece cards: Sabo leader, Zoro-Juurou alt art (OP05-067 ~$32 on TCG Stacked), two Luffy; est total $50-90 < $100 floor
Eight 1986-87 boxed sets (Sportflics Decade Greats, Topps Champion Superstars, Donruss Highlights, Kmart 25th Anniv x2, etc); common sets ~$5-15 each, total <$100-120
Long boxes of bulk MTG commons, $5/100; bulk value pennies per card; no key cards visible
Carved-arm upholstered armchair, reproduction style; local ~$75-150, large item, no 3x
Riftbound Ezreal Dashing alt-art market ~$1.47 (TCG Watchtower); showcase variant not found above ~$20 (estimate)

Box of 4 vintage brass welding regulators with ~7 gauges (Victor/Harris/Airco-style, worn); used vintage regulator sets sell ~$25-60 each on eBay (estimate, no sold page retrievable); check brand marks, gauges intact (glass/needles), CGA threads, not seized; heavy, shipping costly so local

Free 6-arm brass and crystal-drop chandelier with black shades; comparable used chandeliers sell ~$100-250 (estimate); check maker tag/age, solid brass vs plated, all arms/crystals present, wiring okay, you must unmount it
Augusta Arsenal 1862 cartridge-box label shown as modern rubber stamp on wood block with inked impressions; reproduction craft stamps

Several Hilti SP 14x1 universal diamond blades (2117946), some in packaging; retail ~$130-170 each, used/new resale ~$60-90 each (estimate); 4-5 visible so ~$240-350; check count, unused vs worn segments, arbor size 1in
Framed One Piece Portgas D. Ace special-art card; est $40-90, not 3x $65
Binder of many duplicate Suicune reverse/holo cards; low-value duplicates

CGC Pristine 10 Japanese Mewtwo Lv.X Holo 006/012 (2009 Collection Pack, pop low); graded 10s of this card sell ~$100-300 (estimate, comps not retrievable); $1 likely misprice, verify cert on CGC site, case unscratched, label matches
Japanese Base Set Zapdos No.145 holo-style, HP; ~$20-35 sold, priced at value
CAP Olympic weight plates, ~6 visible, mixed sizes; weight/count unknown, ~$0.8/lb local value, heavy, no clear 3x

Wall of boxed Funko Pops (Pokemon Meowth, Star Wars, Doctor Voodoo Walgreens, Smokey Bear, Analyst Walmart, WWE etc), dozens visible, many exclusives; common pops sell ~$6-15 each, lot of 30+ >= $200 conservative (estimate); $1 may be misprice; check count, box condition, chase/exclusive stickers
17 miniature RHS Belladonna-style porcelain plates 1982; collectible set ~$30-60 (estimate), under $100
Gray-Nicolls Gold Edition 3.0 cricket bat; niche local market, ~$100-150 used, asking $125 near value
